visual_enhancers.shadows: Very subtle ambient shadows only for floating elements, e.g. shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #D9D8D3 on cards, no heavy rounded borders, keep max rounded-xl or rounded-2xl
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid huge gradients. Solid soft colors preferred.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Gentle opacity shifts or slight transform (-translate-y-1) for cards. Buttons should scale very slightly and darken.

motion.scroll_reveal: Framer Motion: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: 'easeOut' }}
motion.marquee: react-fast-marquee for the green bar with short wellbeing phrases.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Sections should use py-24 to py-32. Elements gap-8 to gap-16.

component_instructions.header: Sticky with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F8F6]/80, 1px bottom border border-border/40. No transparent headers.
component_instructions.footer: Solid surface background #F0EFEA, large padding py-24, elegant typographic logo treatment.
component_instructions.cards: Subtle borders border-[#D9D8D3], bg-[#F9F8F6] or bg-[#F0EFEA], rounded-2xl, generous internal padding p-8 to p-12. No excessive shadows.
component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), bg-[#8C9A8E] text-white hover:bg-[#78877A] transition-all duration-300 px-8 py-4
component_instructions.accordion: Shadcn accordion, customize to have no outside border, just bottom borders on items, soft text colors.
component_instructions.form: Shadcn forms, inputs with rounded-lg, border-[#D9D8D3], bg-transparent focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#8C9A8E].
component_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react with thin stroke widths (1.5) and text-[#8C9A8E].

Home: Hero: Brand/logo treatment using typography, no photograph, calm copy.
Three Ways to Find Support: 3 cards, icons only, clean and spaced.
Marquee: Green background (#8C9A8E), white text (#F9F8F6), continuous scrolling phrases ('Find your balance', 'A piece of mind', 'Breathe deeply').
Approach/Philosophy: Split layout (text left, soft colored box right).
About: Philosophy, values, approach sections. Vertical flow with generous whitespace.
Support: Individual support, workshops, corporate wellbeing. Presented as elegant cards or split rows.
Corporate_Workshops: Glimpses Gallery: Use the provided abstract nature images in a masonry or neat bento grid.
Contact: Elegant contact form (name, email, phone, message, enquiry type).

accessibility: All interactive elements must include data-testid. Form inputs must have labels. Buttons must have accessible text. Contrast ratios must meet AA standards.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters where appropriate (e.g. headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles, pill-shaped for this project.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, scroll reveals.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use Shadcn components for forms, accordions, etc., but heavily customize them to remove the default SaaS look.
